text:
Maya Singh: quick heads-up, new int8 canary showing small uptick in funcall JSON parse errors (~0.28%).
Liam O'Connor: any sample payloads?
Maya Singh: yep — looks like streaming fragments split inside escaped strings, e.g.
```
[replica1] ...\"data\": \"User said: Hello, wo
[replica2] rld\", \"meta\": {...} ...
```
When concatenated naively sometimes the escape becomes invalid and python json fails.
Sofia Ruiz: that smells like timing changes from quantization shifting token boundaries. We should avoid changing public API first.
Liam O'Connor: short-term fix: arbiter can insert a tiny boundary token (e.g. `<RWD-B>`) between replica chunks and strip before final assembly. That avoids modifying model output.
Maya Singh: agree, plus add a conservative reassembly helper that runs: balance braces, check quote pairing, attempt only safe close-quote fixes, else trigger non-streaming retry. Log every fix.
Sofia Ruiz: add telemetry labels: `reassembly_outcome` (fixed|retry|fail) and `quant_mode` (fp16/ptq/int8).
ops-bot: canary started on eng-ml staging (5201300140)  1% traffic
Liam O'Connor: I'll also add a metric for `frag_ttl_exceeded` when fragments for same call arrive >200ms apart — probably distinct responses.
Maya Singh: ok, let's monitor for 2 hours and reconvene. Thanks.
